purpose: Adapters for Asian institutional slide collections added in 07F.
guards: Treat section-wide specimen totals and slide-subset totals as separate count scopes.
Preserve dated current holdings statistics and update dates.
Where a source says slides exist for many specimens without a count, retain existence and pairing evidence but leave slide count null.

adapters.promotion_rule: Extract each explicitly stated slide count and type subset separately; preserve contradictory or awkward count wording rather than silently reconciling it.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Natural Science Taiwan
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture category count, taxon count and update date; keep plant-section media qualified until item records confirm glass mounting.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Natural Science Taiwan
adapters.target: official donation and acquisition news records
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture named collector, collection period, taxonomic scope, geographic proportions, pre-accession sorting, donation and museum intake as separate events.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Nature and Science Tokyo Botany
adapters.target: microalgae herbarium collection and database page
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture current prepared-slide count, named personal collections and linked specialist databases; separate dried liquid and EM specimen categories.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Nature and Science Tokyo Zoology
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture slide existence, paired specimen/preparation structure and named collection history without converting whole-collection counts into slide counts.
